svg.title: TUSK source-recovered deep-zoom architecture
svg.desc: A recursively nested architecture map recovered from source commit 0e8f2d7760ea98ed28f5e78462b9adc5c536cb09. Existing architecture documentation and diagrams were intentionally not used.
svg.metadata: source_repository=https://github.com/vovka/tusk source_commit=0e8f2d7760ea98ed28f5e78462b9adc5c536cb09 evidence_policy=production source, manifests, deployment configuration, and tests
svg.text: Commit 0e8f2d7 • ordinary browser zoom reveals successively smaller implementation layers

g.title: User supplies speech or typed commands and receives speech, CLI replies, and tray status. Evidence: shells/voice/voice_shell.py; shells/cli/cli_shell.py; shells/tray/tray_shell.py
docker-compose.yml declares the tusk and phoenix services plus phoenix-data volume.
g.text: one TUSK container + optional observability service

g.title: main.py builds configuration, LLM registry, kernel and shells. Dockerfile starts the Python application.
shell_loader.py selects and runs configured CLI, voice, emulator and tray shells; non-final shells run on daemon threads.
g.text: ShellLoader builds configured shells; voice is also tray control

g.title: shells/voice/voice_shell.py composes VoicePipeline; tests/shells/voice/test_pipeline_threading.py confirms capture continues while submission is busy.
g.text: audio capture and VAD run on a producer thread; commands run through CommandWorker

g.title: shells/voice/stages/audio_capture.py — AudioCapture.stream_frames() reads mono int16 frames from sounddevice.
shells/voice/stages/utterance_detector.py — WebRTC VAD groups frames until trailing silence.
shells/voice/stages/transcriber.py — Transcriber.process() delegates to the configured STTEngine.
shells/voice/stages/sanitizer.py and transcription_buffer.py sanitize, retain recent utterances, and track recoverable candidates.
shells/voice/stages/gate/gatekeeper.py — LLMGatekeeper classifies command, conversation, interrupt, recovery, or drop with an LLM slot.
shell_loader.py wraps gates with PlaybackGate and SpeechStopGate so only the stop-gate LLM can interrupt TUSK speech.
shells/voice/command_worker.py — a daemon worker queue serializes kernel submission, acknowledgement and spoken reply.
shells/voice/stages/chunked_speaker.py — TTS chunks are synthesized on a producer thread and played while later chunks are generated.
shells/cli/cli_shell.py loops over input(), submits text, and prints KernelResponse.reply.
shells/emulator/emulator_shell.py provides an emulated input shell used by demos and tests.
shells/tray/tray_shell.py attaches TrayStatusSink and exposes pause, resume, logs, restart and quit actions.
shells/tray/tray_status_sink.py renders status snapshots through an AppIndicator backend.
shells/tray/tray_menu_actions.py and tray_shell.py call VoiceShell.pause/resume and process restart/quit operations.
tusk/kernel contains KernelAPI, command and mode routing, the internal agent runtime, tool registry, adapter manager, and persistent session store.
g.text: serial request boundary, modes, agent backend, tool execution, session events

g.title: tusk/kernel/core/kernel_api.py — KernelAPI.submit() serializes requests, traces them, reports status and routes to the active mode.
tusk/kernel/core/command_mode.py and tusk/kernel/modes implement default conversation/command routing plus switchable dictation and coding modes.
tusk/kernel/core/command_mode.py — CommandMode keeps a conversation session but uses transient sessions for one-shot commands.
tusk/kernel/modes/mode_slot.py — ModeSlot owns the active AdapterMode and mode-specific gate callbacks.
tusk/kernel/modes/mode_gate.py — ModeGate uses the stop_gate LLM slot with mode-specific prompts.
tusk/kernel/modes/dictation_router.py; tests/kernel/modes/test_dictation_router.py confirm adapter processing followed by gnome.type_text or replace_recent_text.
tusk/kernel/modes/coding_router.py; tests/kernel/modes/test_coding_router.py confirm planned operations are applied through an edit strategy and editor driver.
tusk/kernel/agent/backends/agent_backend_factory.py selects exactly one configured backend, with optional fallback to the internal TUSK backend.
tusk/kernel/agent/backends/agent_backend_factory.py — create() chooses configured backend and can wrap it in FallbackAgentBackend.
tusk/kernel/agent/backends/tusk_agent_backend.py delegates to MainAgent.process_command().
tusk/kernel/agent/backends/codex_exec_agent_backend.py invokes a codex subprocess for each request and parses structured JSON output.
tusk/kernel/agent/backends/codex_mcp_agent_backend.py drives one persistent codex mcp-server process and reuses thread IDs.
tusk/kernel/agent implements an internal multi-profile orchestration loop with session lineage, tool selection, planner validation, sequence execution and guarded delegation.
tusk/kernel/core/main_agent.py — MainAgent separates conversational sessions from fast one-shot command sessions and shares command outcomes into conversation history.
tusk/kernel/agent/agent_orchestrator.py — validates requests, builds toolsets, runs profiles, delegates child agents, validates planner output and dispatches tools.
tusk/kernel/agent/agent_runtime.py — performs bounded LLM tool-call steps until done, interruption, guard violation, repeated call, failure, or max steps.
tusk/kernel/core/agent_profiles.py constructs conversation, command, planner, executor and default profiles from named LLM registry slots.
tusk/kernel/core/main_agent.py marks a one-shot command with runtime_tool_names=("*",) and gate_command=True.
tusk/kernel/agent/agent_tool_catalog.py and planner modules expose a tool catalog and validate selected tool names and planned steps.
tusk/kernel/agent/tool_sequence/executor.py and tests/kernel/agent/test_sequence_agent_flow.py confirm validated sequence plans execute sequence-callable tools through a meta-tool.
tusk/kernel/core/agent_profiles.py provides a default profile slot for delegated general work.
tusk/kernel/agent/agent_toolset_builder.py filters static tools and runtime tools by profile, request, visibility and sequence mode.
tusk/kernel/agent/orchestrator_tool_dispatcher.py routes run_agent, execute_tool_sequence, and registered runtime tool calls.
tusk/kernel/agent/runtime/turn_guards.py and repeated_tool_call_guard.py stop invalid profile behavior and repeated identical calls.
tusk/kernel/agent/runtime/step_recorder.py records user messages, tool calls and tool results to the Store.
tusk/kernel/tools and tusk/kernel/core/adapter_manager.py establish a unified namespaced ToolRegistry populated by internal tools and dynamic MCP adapters.
tusk/kernel/tools/tool_registry.py — ToolRegistry stores namespaced tools and filters planner-visible and sequence-callable subsets.
tusk/kernel/core/adapter_manager.py; tests/kernel/test_adapter_manager.py confirm subprocess startup and registration as source.tool.
tusk/kernel/tools/tool_runtime.py wires dictation/coding routers and registers start-mode and switch-model tools.
tusk/shared/mcp/mcp_client.py and mcp_stdio_transport.py implement ordered JSON-RPC request/response over child-process stdin/stdout.
AdapterWatcher observes immediate child directories of adapters/; detailed filesystem watcher mechanics are summarized here.
tusk/kernel/agent/session/file_store.py stores append-only JSONL events in Config.agent_session_log_dir.
tusk/shared provides typed schemas, configuration, LLM proxy/registry/retry, status reporting, logging, interruption, MCP transport and tracing abstractions.
tusk/shared/schemas contains dataclasses for utterances, tool calls/results, plans, desktop context, statuses and kernel responses.
tusk/shared/llm contains LLMProvider abstractions, LLMProxy, LLMRegistry, JSON handling and retry policy.
tusk/shared/status/status_reporter_hub.py fans status updates to sinks, including the tray sink attached at runtime.
tusk/shared/interrupt/interrupt_token.py coordinates cancellation across worker, agent runtime and speech playback.
tusk/shared/tracing/tracer_factory.py returns NullTracer or an OTLP-backed OpenTelemetry tracer.
tusk/providers implements selectable LLM and STT providers plus Groq TTS, behind shared interfaces.
tusk/providers/llm/configurable_llm_factory.py chooses GroqLLM or OpenRouterLLM for each named LLM slot.
tusk/providers/llm/configurable_llm_factory.py
tusk/providers/llm/groq_llm.py calls Groq chat completions for text, structured output and required/auto tool calls.
tusk/providers/llm/open_router_llm.py calls https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 through the OpenAI-compatible client.
tusk/providers/stt/stt_engine_factory.py chooses local WhisperSTT or remote GroqSTT from STT_ENGINE configuration.
tusk/providers/stt/whisper_stt.py loads an OpenAI Whisper model and transcribes PCM locally.
tusk/providers/stt/groq_stt.py converts PCM to WAV and calls Groq audio.transcriptions with whisper-large-v3-turbo.
tusk/providers/tts/groq_tts.py splits reply text into at most 200-character chunks and calls Groq speech synthesis.
AdapterManager spawns each adapters/*/server.py manifest entry as a separate process and communicates over JSON-RPC 2.0 stdin/stdout.
g.text: manifest-discovered • one process per adapter • namespaced tools registered in kernel

g.title: adapters/gnome/adapter.json and server.py declare a context-providing stdio MCP service with desktop tools.
adapters/gnome/server.py builds GnomeToolRouter and serves it through tusk.shared.mcp.MCPStdioServer.
adapters/gnome/gnome_tool_router.py groups application, clipboard, context, input and window handlers.
adapters/gnome/tools/application_tools.py searches .desktop entries, launches through /tmp/tusk/launch.sock, opens URIs, and observes new windows.
adapters/gnome/gnome_context_provider.py reads active and open windows with xdotool and wmctrl, plus applications from .desktop files.
adapters/gnome/tools/input_tools.py and gnome_input_simulator.py drive keyboard and mouse operations using xdotool.
adapters/gnome/tools/window_tools.py drives close, focus, maximize, minimize, geometry, and workspace operations through wmctrl/xdotool.
adapters/gnome/tools/clipboard_tools.py and gnome_clipboard_provider.py read and write the GNOME clipboard.

g.text: tool catalog: launch/open • window control • keys/text/mouse • clipboard • desktop context
summarized: validation and argument conversion inside individual tool classes

g.title: adapters/dictation/adapter.json and server.py declare a stateful dictation cleanup MCP service.
adapters/dictation/server.py — DictationServer creates session IDs, accumulates segments and returns insert operations.
adapters/dictation/dictation_session_store.py holds dictation sessions and prunes stale entries.
adapters/dictation/dictation_refiner.py contains LLM-assisted refinement support; the current server path returns direct insert segments.
g.text: architectural status inferred from imports and current construction path

g.title: adapters/coding/adapter.json and server.py declare an MCP service that plans full-buffer coding edits using an LLM.
g.text: in-memory buffers • LLM edit planner • JSON-RPC stdio

g.title: adapters/coding/server.py — CodingServer starts sessions, asks CodingEditPlanner for a new buffer, and returns a replace operation.
adapters/coding/coding_edit_planner.py — CodingEditPlanner uses an LLM provider to produce a replacement buffer from intent and existing content.
adapters/coding/server.py _replace_operation() returns a replace EditOperation spanning the old buffer line range.
docker-compose.yml declares arizephoenix/phoenix:17.25.0 on port 6006; TUSK exports OTLP HTTP spans when TRACING_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.
docker-compose.yml mounts named volume phoenix-data at /mnt/data.
When AGENT_BACKEND is codex_exec or codex_mcp, TUSK invokes the configured codex binary in the same container; exact remote service behavior is outside this repository.
docker-compose.yml mounts X11, PulseAudio, D-Bus, desktop application directories and /tmp/tusk into the TUSK container; GNOME adapter code invokes desktop CLI tools.
adapters/gnome uses xdotool, wmctrl, X11, D-Bus and desktop files to inspect and control the user's graphical session.
docker-compose.yml exposes /dev/snd and PulseAudio; AudioCapture reads the microphone while paplay emits TTS audio.
GnomeContextProvider and GnomeInputSimulator call xdotool and wmctrl against the mounted X11 display.
TrayShell uses AppIndicator and the host D-Bus session to render status and receive menu actions.
adapters/gnome/app_catalog.py reads .desktop files from mounted host directories and targets arbitrary desktop applications.
g.text: .desktop catalog • active/open windows • editable text fields

g.title: launcher/tusk_host_launcher.py is a separately started host-side process. It accepts commands on /tmp/tusk/launch.sock and starts GUI applications as the host user.
g.text: auxiliary process; startup outside docker-compose is not declared

g.title: launcher/tusk_host_launcher.py binds /tmp/tusk/launch.sock with mode 0700; tests/test_tusk_host_launcher.py confirms owner-only socket permissions.
g.text: receive command → sanitize Snap env → subprocess.Popen

g.title: Remote provider boundaries are directly supported by tusk/providers implementations. Specific model choice is configuration-driven.
tusk/providers/llm/groq_llm.py, stt/groq_stt.py and tts/groq_tts.py call the Groq SDK for chat completions, audio transcription and speech synthesis.
tusk/providers/llm/open_router_llm.py fixes base_url=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 and uses an OpenAI-compatible client.
Legend. Dashed borders and edges denote configuration-dependent, optional, or inferred elements as described in tooltips.

g.text: fit screen = system • ~4× = deployables • ~16× = modules • ~64× = classes • ~200× = methods
